long_biography.plain_text:
Twenty years as governor of Hail gave Prince Muqrin bin Abdulaziz Al Saud his longest public assignment. The former Royal Saudi Air Force officer oversaw a period of urban, cultural and agricultural development before moving to govern Medina, then taking charge of the General Intelligence Presidency.

At national level, Muqrin served as second deputy prime minister, deputy crown prince and, briefly, crown prince. His interests extend beyond public office to agricultural research, astronomy and Arabic poetry. An avid reader, he assembled a personal library of about 10,000 books and brought those interests into public and private seminars.
